sentences.text:
Amar Marandi, aged about 19 years, S/o. Chhote Lal Marandi @ Chhotan Marandi, R/o. Ledadih,
Rajganj, P.O. & P.S.-Rajganj, Dist.-
 Dhanbad.

Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath
------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Naveen Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Ruby Pandey, A.P.P.

2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Rajganj P.S. Case No. 35/2024, for the offences registered under Sections 498A, 306/34 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Dhanbad.
3.
The petitioner happens to be husband of the deceased, who died in her matrimonial home.
4. Attention has been drawn towards paragraph 57 & 58 of the Case Diary.
It appears that witness has stated that the deceased committed suicide because she was fed up with drinking habits of the petitioner.
5. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Amar Marandi vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
